turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I write no gifts please on an invitation without sounding snooty?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it warm and give a reason. For example, your company is the only present we need.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay so I'm making macarons for our six month anniversary and I'm kind of freaking out.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally doable. Do you want the French method, which is simpler but fussier about technique, or the Italian one with hot sugar syrup, which is more stable?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me a moment, Moshi, I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, would you ever swap rooms with me? The buses outside mine start at five.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Mine's next to the boiler though. It clunks all night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Clunking I can handle. Brakes squealing at five I can't.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm. If you give me your big wardrobe, maybe.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seriously? Done. Can we move stuff this weekend?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sunday. After I've had a lie-in, obviously.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you ready to leave or do you still need your coat?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Two minutes, I can't find my scarf.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done chatting. Go ahead, I'm listening.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Back on the anniversary macarons. Which way are you leaning?
